articles.title: At 17, Gilberto Mora Just Shattered a 96-Year-Old World Cup Record—and He's Only Getting Started
articles.summary: When Mexico kicked off the 2026 World Cup, a teenager named Gilberto Mora stole the show—not with a goal, but by calmly completing every pass. At 17 years and 240 days, he became the youngest Mexican ever on the sport's biggest stage, breaking a record from 1930.

articles.title: Forget Mars—Earth Is the Solar System's True MVP, and Here's Why
articles.summary: Earth isn't just our home; it's a cosmic jackpot. With a perfect temperature for liquid water, a protective atmosphere that vaporizes 10 million kilograms of meteors daily, and life in every corner, our planet is uniquely awesome. Plus, we know less about our oceans than the moon's surface.

articles.title: Australia: A Continent-Sized Country Where Deadly Spiders Meet the World's Largest Rock
articles.summary: Australia is the only nation that covers an entire continent, and it's packed with extremes: scorching deserts, lush rainforests, unique wildlife like kangaroos and platypuses, and 36 species of venomous funnel-web spiders. Nearly a quarter of its people were born overseas, and its ancient Aboriginal culture dates back 50,000 years.
